eli5.text: When you ask the system to use a specific version of a Claude model through a particular provider, it now connects to the right model instead of failing or picking the wrong one. If you were trying to use that version before, your request would not have resolved correctly, and now it does.

ai.title: Add Account tab to web profile page
ai.summary: New `AccountSection` component added to `web/src/app/profile/components/`. It displays the user's email and verification status via `useSession`. The profile page sidebar now includes an 'Account' tab linking to this section.

eli5.text: Logged-in users now see a new 'Account' tab on their profile page that displays their email address and whether it's verified. The tab appears alongside existing profile sections like billing and referrals, so if you navigate to your profile you can click 'Account' in the sidebar to view your email and confirmation status. This change is live today for all users who can access the profile page.

ai.title: Discord bot clarifies GitHub primary email requirement
ai.summary: Discord bot commands and error messages updated to specify the primary email for the GitHub account used for Codebuff. The `register-commands.ts` option description and `client.ts` reply content now reference the GitHub primary email and include a link to the profile settings. This change affects the Discord integration surface within the web package. The `env.NEXT_PUBLIC_CODEBUFF_APP_URL` is used to construct the direct link to `/profile?tab=account` for user guidance.

eli5.text: When you ask the Discord bot about your account, it now explains that you must use the primary email tied to the GitHub account connected to your Codebuff profile, and it points you to the account settings page where that email is listed. If you forget to include an email or provide one that cannot be matched, the bot's error message spells out exactly where to find the right address instead of leaving you to guess. This applies to anyone using the Discord bot to manage their Codebuff account starting today.

ai.title: Add confirmation dialog to auto top-up
ai.summary: Auto top-up settings now display a confirmation dialog when enabling the feature with a current balance below the configured threshold. This prevents accidental immediate charges by requiring explicit user consent. The change updates the `useAutoTopup` hook to fetch the live balance and modifies `AutoTopupSettings.tsx` to render the new `ConfirmationDialog`. Additionally, the default and maximum threshold constants were adjusted in `constants.ts`.

eli5.text: When you turn on the automatic top-up feature while your balance is already below the trigger level, you will now see a confirmation dialog asking you to explicitly accept the immediate top-up charge before it goes through. This prevents accidental charges if you did not realize your balance was low. The feature is live today for users managing their auto top-up settings through the web app.

ai.title: Reorder completions credit check after subscription grant logic
ai.summary: In web/src/app/api/v1/chat/completions/_post.ts, the credit check moved after ensureSubscriberBlockGrant. Previously, totalRemaining <= 0 triggered a 402 before subscription block grant validation, incorrectly blocking subscribers whose subscription credits are excluded from totalRemaining. The fix introduces subscriberHasAvailableCredits, set true when a block grant succeeds or on fail-open errors, allowing subscribers to bypass the a-la-carte credit check. Covers the completions API endpoint and its tests.

eli5.text: Paying subscribers who run out of pay-per-use credits can now make requests again even when their account balance shows zero. After verifying your subscription block grant, the system will let your request go through if you have subscription credits available; if the subscription check fails for any reason, it errs on the side of letting the request proceed. What you'd notice: if you're a subscriber and your a-la-carte credits are exhausted, your chat requests no longer get rejected with a 'out of credits' message when your subscription block grant is active. This only affects subscribers; non-subscribers with zero balance still see the out-of-credits message.
